verdict.rationale: Pipedream is a hosted workflow and integration platform, so self-hosting is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted deployment of the core product. The open-source material covers only the trigger and action components, and a community user notes the workflow engine itself is not open source. The CLI deploys to Pipedream's own cloud, not to user infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
